level_scope_note: Full-season affiliated levels only. Rookie/CPX and DSL are NOT included and are not supported by the canonical model.
accounting_identity: total_value_runs = batting_runs + baserunning_runs + sdr_runs + position_runs + league_adjustment_runs + replacement_runs ; eWAR = total_value_runs / runs_per_win
known_limitations: Catcher defensive value covers balls in play only; framing, blocking and throwing are NOT observed and are declared per row.
2026 is not included: the defensive substrate (SDR era refit, d02, league environment, park) does not exist for 2026.
Rookie/CPX and DSL are out of scope.
